title: Inzwi reUchenjeri Mumumvuri
intro: Munhu wekare, anozivikanwa nekunzwisisa kwakadzama, anotaura newe kwemazana emakore. Munhu uyu haana kumbobvira azviti muprofita, asi huchenjeri hwaMwari hwakayerera mumashoko avo. Semubereki akasiya nhaka yekusingaperi yenhungamiro, mazano avo achiri mumoyo yemamiriyoni evanhu, achiverengwa uye achifungwa nezvawo nanhasi.
clues: Ndakagamuchira chipo chaMwari chakandisiyanisa nevamwe - uchenjeri hwakadzama zvekuti hwakava hunhu hwangu hwakandisiyanisa nevamwe munhoroondo yese.
Ndakanga ndisiri mutumwa kana ngirozi - ndaingova mweya wakakomborerwa nekunzwisisa kwakadzama uye kunzwisisa nyika.
Ukama hwangu hwepedyo hwaiva nemwana wangu, uye kuburikidza nehukama uhwu, shoko rangu rinogara kwenguva refu rakasvika.
Ndakakurudzira kutenda kuna Iye akandipa zvese, uye ndakanyevera nezvekuzvikudza nekuzvikudza.
Ndakadzidzisa nezvekurema kwemabasa embeu yemasitadhi, uye kukosha kwekuderedza inzwi rako nekuzvininipisa.
Chitsauko muQuran chine zita rangu, uko zano rangu kumwanakomana wangu anodiwa rinochengetedzwa nekusingaperi.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
